demos.title: Office network with an ARP spoofing attack
demos.blurb: A small office network (simulated, 13 minutes). A smart plug joins, the printer gets a new network card, a laptop scans another computer, and then an attacker's virtual machine starts pretending to be the router (an Ettercap-style ARP spoofing attack).

demos.title: Same network, no attack
demos.blurb: Another day on the same network (simulated, 10 minutes): a new device joins, and the internet router is swapped for a backup router with a different MAC address. There is no attack: ARPGuard should stay calm.
